ServerConfig.description: Server configuration for openscience serve and web commands

cors.description: Additional domains to allow for CORS

description.description: Description of when to use the agent

hidden.description: Hide this subagent from the @ autocomplete menu (default: false, only applies to mode: subagent)

color.description: Hex color code for the agent (e.g., #FF5733)

steps.description: Maximum number of agentic iterations before forcing text-only response

disabled.description: Disable this variant for the model

tokenCommand.description: Shell command whose stdout is a short-lived bearer token. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on every request and re-minted automatically before the token's JWT exp (or every request for a non-JWT token). Use for providers behind rotating/SSO-minted credentials.

enterpriseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise URL for copilot authentication

setCacheKey.description: Enable promptCacheKey for this provider (default false)

timeout.description: Optional total wall-clock timeout in milliseconds for a provider request. No total timeout is applied by default. Use idleTimeout to bound silent connections without cutting off active generations.

anyOf.description: Optional total wall-clock timeout in milliseconds for a provider request. No total timeout is applied by default; active long-running generations are allowed to finish.
Explicitly disable the optional total wall-clock timeout.

idleTimeout.description: Maximum provider inactivity in milliseconds while connecting or waiting for the next response-body chunk. Defaults to 300000 (5 minutes), resets on each body chunk, and does not cap total generation time.

anyOf.description: Maximum provider inactivity in milliseconds while connecting or waiting for the next response-body chunk. Defaults to 300000 (5 minutes) and resets on every body chunk.

command.description: Command and arguments to run the MCP server

environment.description: Environment variables to set when running the MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID. If not provided, dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) will be attempted.

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret (if required by the authorization server)

scope.description: OAuth scopes to request during authorization

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

headers.description: Headers to send with the request

oauth.description: OAuth authentication configuration for the MCP server. Set to false to disable OAuth auto-detection.

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

SandboxConfig.description: OS-level execution sandbox for the agent's shell commands.

enabled.description: Run local terminals, kernels, and shell commands inside an OS sandbox (macOS Seatbelt / Linux bubblewrap) that confines writes to authorized project roots. Disabled by default; enable it from the composer or Sandbox settings.

network.description: Whether sandboxed commands may reach the network. Default: deny.

allowWrite.description: Extra absolute paths — beyond the workspace and temp dirs — the sandbox may write to.

onUnavailable.description: Behaviour when no sandbox backend exists on this platform: 'error' (default) refuses to run, 'warn' runs unsandboxed with a notice, and 'allow' runs unsandboxed silently.

requireProjectTrust.description: Require explicit project trust before any execution, even when a verified OS sandbox is available. Default: false.

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for configuration validation

theme.description: Theme name to use for the interface

autoupdate.description: Automatically update to the latest version. Set to true to auto-update, false to disable, or 'notify' to show update notifications

disabled_providers.description: Disable providers that are loaded automatically

enabled_providers.description: When set, ONLY these providers will be enabled. All other providers will be ignored

model.description: Model to use in the format of provider/model, eg anthropic/claude-2

small_model.description: Small model to use for tasks like title generation in the format of provider/model

default_agent.description: Default agent to use when none is specified. Must be a primary agent. Falls back to 'research' if not set or if the specified agent is invalid.

billing.description: Managed Credits vs bring-your-own-key spend, toggled independently for LLM inference and compute.

llm.description: How LLM inference is paid for. 'managed' uses Credits; 'byok' uses your own provider API keys or first-party OAuth (ChatGPT/Claude Pro/Copilot) and is never billed. Unset or null = auto-detect from the resolved credential.

compute.description: How GPU/compute is paid for. 'managed' runs on Atlas-provisioned compute billed to your wallet (via the bundled atlas CLI); 'byok' uses your own connected GPU providers (Modal, Tinker, TensorPool, …). Unset = byok.

username.description: Custom username to display in conversations instead of system username

provider.description: Custom provider configurations and model overrides

instructions.description: Additional instruction files or patterns to include

auto.description: Enable automatic compaction when context is full (default: true)

prune.description: Enable pruning of old tool outputs (default: true)

threshold.description: Compact when context exceeds this fraction of the model window (default: 0.75)

fallbackContext.description: Assumed context window (tokens) when a provider reports 0 (default: 128000)

tailTurns.description: Minimum recent turns kept verbatim during compaction (default: 2)

tailTokens.description: Token budget for the verbatim recent tail during compaction (default: clamp(0.20*usable, 8000, 32000))

chatMaxRetries.description: Number of retries for chat completions on failure

openTelemetry.description: Enable OpenTelemetry spans for AI SDK calls (using the 'experimental_telemetry' flag)

primary_tools.description: Tools that should only be available to primary agents.

continue_loop_on_deny.description: Continue the agent loop when a tool call is denied

plan_mode.description: Replace TodoWrite with PlanWrite and show plan panel in sidebar

mcp_timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for model context protocol (MCP) requests

startCommand.description: Additional startup script to run after the project's start command
